step1_analysis.description: A cross-coupled inverter pair with a tail current source and precharge transistors. It amplifies a small initial voltage difference on its internal nodes into a full CMOS logic level when enabled.

paper_reference.title: Yield and Speed Optimization of a Latch-Type Voltage Sense Amplifier

sensing_delay.description: Time from the enable signal (EN) reaching 50% VDD to the output node (V2) discharging to 50% VDD.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly stated, but speed optimization is a key focus.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay ≈ C_load * (VDD/2) / I_discharge. With W=5u, L=0.5u, C_load is ~20fF. I_discharge is limited by the tail NMOS and cross-coupled NMOS in series, roughly 2mA. Delay ≈ 20fF * 0.9V / 2mA = 9ps. Adding EN rise time and parasitic effects, expect 20ps - 100ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on SKY130 NMOS drive strength and estimated parasitic capacitance of the W=5u devices.

average_power.description: Average power consumption during the sensing phase.

sky130_expected.calculation: Energy per sensing event ≈ C * VDD^2 = 20fF * 1.8^2 = 65fJ. Over a 3ns measurement window, average power = 65fJ / 3ns ≈ 21uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on dynamic power charging/discharging the internal nodes.

initial_vdiff.description: Initial voltage difference between V1 and V2 before sensing begins.

sky130_expected.calculation: A 50uA current source pulls down V2 against the precharge PMOS (XM7). Ron of XM7 ≈ 1 / (50uA/V^2 * 10 * (1.8-0.42)) ≈ 1.45kΩ. Vdiff = 50uA * 1.45kΩ = 72.5mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the testbench setup to simulate a typical SRAM bitline differential voltage.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the sensing delay and power consumption of the latch-type sense amplifier. A 50uA current source is used to create an initial voltage difference between V1 and V2 during the precharge phase.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Latch-Type Sense Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

XM1 V1 V2 N_TAIL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 V1 V2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 V2 V1 N_TAIL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 V2 V1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N_TAIL EN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 V1 EN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 V2 EN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VEN EN 0 PULSE(0 1.8 2n 50p 50p 10n 20n)
I_diff V2 0 50u

.control
tran 1p 10n
meas tran v1_init find v(V1) at=1.9n
meas tran v2_init find v(V2) at=1.9n
meas tran delay trig v(EN) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(V2) val=0.9 fall=1
let pwr = -i(VVDD)*1.8
meas tran avg_power avg pwr from=2n to=5n
meas tran i_peak min i(VVDD)
quit
.endc
.end
